messages:
alex: Heads up — apps-of-apps triggered a massive bulk reconcile 45m ago, we're seeing API 429s from control-plane and the GPU pool autoscaler is stuck. cost alert already fired. anyone looking?
jamie: I'm on logs now. seeing huge appset fanout + GC jobs from argocd. lots of Postgres connection errors to git-server too.
olga: paste of argocd logs: ```time=\"2026-03-17T14:50:12Z\" level=error msg=\"sync failed\" app=my-appset error=\"failed to list resources: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = API rate limit\"```
maria: SRE bot also pushed an alert: \"argocd-controller: 429 spike\" and a k8s event burst.
sre-bot: ALERT: argocd-controller high 429 rate detected (threshold 100/min). GPU autoscaler: reconcile delayed.
jamie: Looks like garbage-collection kicked in for a bunch of old helmrelease/helmrelease-hook jobs from last week's rollout. GC + reconcile = thundering herd.
eng-infra-oncall: Quick mitigation idea: pause GC for the affected appset, reduce appset parallelism, and add a short reconcile window. Can someone annotate the parent app?
alex: I'll annotate the app-of-apps to skip reconcile for 30m. Command: `kubectl -n argocd patch app my-apps -p '{\"metadata\":{\"annotations\":{\"argocd.argoproj.io/skip-reconcile\":\"true\"}}}' --type=merge`
olga: Also lowering argocd controller concurrency at runtime helped before. We can edit the `argocd-cm` to set `resource.customizations`? or better: scale argocd-repo-server to 3 replicas to relieve git-server traffic.
maria: Repo-server scale + temporary skip should stop the 429s. But note: skipping will delay some infra rollouts (gpu nodes). We should notify infra owners.
jamie: There's a cost angle — autoscaler queued many pending nodes which then timed out and we charged ephemeral spot requests. I flagged finance to expect a small spike.
eng-infra-oncall: Action items: 1) alex annotate skip-reconcile (in progress). 2) olga scale repo-server to 3. 3) jamie identify the offending apps causing GC churn. 4) deploy-bot will hold any automated bulk reconcile for 1h.
deploy-bot: HOLD: automated reconcile jobs paused for appset 'bulk-gpu-apps' until 2026-03-17T16:40:00Z UTC.
olga: Quick note on longer-term fixes: stagger appset rollouts using `reconcileWindow` labels, add rate limiting in front of git-server, and tune argocd's `appSyncLimit`/`parallelism` (controller flags). Also consider splitting mega app-of-apps into smaller shards.
jamie: I'll open a follow-up infra PR to add staggered reconcile schedules and a runbook for GC bursts.
alex: Thanks. If 429s stop after skip+scale, we'll re-enable reconciling slowly. ping me if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
eng-infra-oncall: updating incident doc and postmortem placeholder.
